---
title: "Grid fit"
subtitle: "Named frames only, asserted or refused"
---

`storecard.fit` takes a card's coordinate sample (edges plus a central cross
of the 2-D longitude and latitude arrays) and asks one narrow question: is
this grid regular in one of a short list of published frames?

```sh
python -m storecard URL --stac COLLECTION --fit
```

## Method

1. Project the sampled cell centres into each frame with osgeo.gdal: polar
   stereographic north and south (NSIDC and WGS84 forms), EASE-Grid 1 and 2,
   web Mercator, and longitude/latitude.
2. Fit one affine per frame by least squares.
3. Pass a frame only if every sampled centre is within 0.001 cell of the
   fitted grid.
4. Snap the passing transform to its shortest decimal form and check it
   again. The roundest passing transform wins; the other passes are
   recorded.
5. If no frame passes, record a refusal that lists every frame and its
   residual.

## The contract

From step 2 of the brief, held by `tests/test_fit.py`: recover EPSG:3412
and the exact transform from `f03d-asi-latlon2d`, which has only 2-D lon/lat,
and refuse the tripolar `f08c-esm-geo2d`.

| Store | Result | Detail |
| ----- | ------ | ------ |
| f03d (published) | EPSG:3412 | 5.3e-10 cells; transform `[3125, 0, -3950000, 0, -3125, 4350000]` exactly after snapping |
| f03d | also within tolerance | EPSG:3976 and EPSG:3031 at 1.1e-4 cells, at pixel sizes that are not round, so not chosen |
| f03d | far off | the north frames (1.1e6 cells), EASE (64 to 1484), web Mercator and lon/lat (over 2e4) |
| f08c (local only) | refused | best frame 475 cells off |

The demo [repeats the f03d check over every cell](demo/index.html#evidence)
in the browser: all 6,714,368 cells are within 7.1e-10 cells.

## Why so narrow

Grid inference in general belongs to
[degredation](https://github.com/hypertidy/degredation): a rectilinear test, candidate CRSs from
the coordinates' geometry, regularity in projected space, resolution
snapping, half-cell extent recovery and a known-grid table. storecard does
not reimplement it. The card's `coord_sample` carries what degredation's
`detect_grid` needs, so inference can run from the card alone, and its fits
should fill the same assertion evidence fields.
